overall_notes: This paper focuses on cross-lingual question answering with strong emphasis on retrieval and answer generation components. Evaluation is entirely automated using standard QA metrics. The paper introduces several technical innovations (single encoder architecture, self-training, generative reader) but doesn't conduct human or LLM-based evaluation.
